proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem apply_le_nfp (H : IsNormal f) {a b} : f b ≤ nfp f a ↔ b ≤ nfp f a := by
  simpa [nfp] using
    (apply_le_nfpFamily (ι := Unit) (f := fun _ : Unit => f) (hι := ⟨()⟩)
      (fun _ => H) (a := a) (b := b))
